command_executed: ./websearch --no-cache -m reason "Kubernetes pod DNS resolution fails intermittently with SERVFAIL for external domains but cluster-internal service discovery works fine and CoreDNS pods show no errors in logs"

evaluation.summary: 3.8/5.0 - Good coverage of forwarding and ndots causes with actionable commands, but misses conntrack table exhaustion entirely
evaluation.key_strengths: Clearly explains why internal resolution works while external fails, and provides concrete kubectl commands and dnsConfig YAML for ndots tuning.
evaluation.key_weaknesses: Completely omits conntrack UDP table exhaustion and source port reuse, which is the primary intermittent cause of this well-known Kubernetes DNS issue; also lacks conntrack diagnostic commands.
